subject: Offer approval: SDE-III package — vesting cadence and sign-on adjustment
body:
From: Adept Recruiting <offers@adeptrecruiting.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Offer draft for Samira Khan (SDE-III)

Hi Neha,

Attached is the initial offer package for Samira Khan for the SDE-III role (REQ REDW-1034). Key terms in the draft:
- Base: $195,000
- Target bonus: 12% annually
- Equity: 0.20% (4-year vesting, 1-year cliff, monthly thereafter)
- Sign-on: $15,000 (one-time)
- Start date: target Jan 4, 2027

Attachments: SDE3_offer_draft_20261101.pdf

Samira has asked whether we can improve the equity cadence (she prefers faster post-cliff vesting) or increase sign-on slightly to cover relocation. Please advise on what we can approve.

Thanks,
Hank Riley
Adept Recruiting
offers@adeptrecruiting.com

---
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: offers@adeptrecruiting.com
Date: 2026-11-01 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Offer draft for Samira Khan (SDE-III) — comp approval request

Team — forwarding Hank's draft. Quick asks:
1) Candidate would like faster vesting cadence after the 1-year cliff (monthly -> quarterly or front-loaded 18-month acceleration). Can we accommodate?
2) Would you approve increasing sign-on to $20k (from $15k) to cover relocation?
3) Equity bump to 0.25% (instead of 0.20%) to match comp band midpoint for SDE-III in SF region.

Budget constraints: this is a critical IC hire for infra. If we need to keep cash down, prefer equity lift. Please reply with the preferred combination and I will send the counter.

Neha Kapoor
Hiring Manager, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

---
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01 18:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Offer draft for Samira Khan (SDE-III) — comp approval request

Neha — reviewed against the SDE-III band. Notes:
- Band midpoint supports up to 0.30% for strong candidates, but median offers have been 0.20–0.25% recently.
- We have some flexibility on sign-on but we should prefer equity where possible to stay within OTE expectations.
- If we want faster cadence, we can offer standard 4-year vesting with 1-year cliff + monthly thereafter but provide a front-loaded 18-month schedule that vests 45% by month 18 (this is an uncommon but acceptable tweak for senior hires).

Recommendation for a clean, approvable counter:
- Base: $195,000 (no change)
- Target bonus: 12%
- Equity: 0.25% (4y vest, 1y cliff, monthly thereafter)
- Sign-on: $20,000 (one-time)

This keeps cash slightly higher than draft but compensates with modest equity. I attached the comp-band-table.xlsx showing where 0.25% sits relative to other SDE-III offers.

If Karthik OKs the sign-on increase, we can proceed. If not, offer 0.25% and keep sign-on at $15k.

Marissa Cole
Compensation & Talent Programs
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: comp-band-table.xlsx

---
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Offer draft for Samira Khan (SDE-III) — comp approval request

Marissa / Neha — I reviewed headcount and cost forecast for infra Q1. Approve the recommended counter:
- Base $195k
- Bonus 12%
- Equity 0.25% (4y, 1y cliff)
- Sign-on $20k (one-time)

Please note: sign-on to be charged to hiring manager's budget; relocation reimbursement should be handled separately and capped at $7,500 if requested. No change to start date timeline.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Engineering Operations
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

---
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@gmail.com>, offers@adeptrecruiting.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Final offer: SDE-III (Samira Khan) — Redwood Inference

Hi Samira / Hank —

Thanks for the patience. Per the comp team and Ops approval, Redwood is prepared to extend the following offer to Samira for the SDE-III role (REQ REDW-1034):

- Base salary: $195,000
- Target bonus: 12% of base, paid annually
- Equity: 0.25% of company common stock, 4-year vesting with a 1-year cliff, monthly vesting thereafter
- Sign-on: $20,000 (one-time)
- Relocation: reimbursement up to $7,500 (if applicable)
- Target start date: Jan 4, 2027 (flexible)

We can accommodate a modified vesting cadence conversationally — while the legal paperwork will reflect the standard schedule above, we are open to operationally recognizing a small front-loading in the early months (to be discussed internally) if that helps Samira feel comfortable.

Attached is the offer PDF. When you are ready, please review and sign via DocuSign: https://docusign.net/offer/REDW-20261101-SDE3.

Attachments: SDE3_offer_draft_20261101.pdf

Next steps: Hank, please route the signed DocuSign back to me and I will kick off onboarding. If Samira wants to negotiate further on vesting cadence, send specifics and we can loop legal.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Hiring Manager, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

---
